about: What some documents must contain, by law or policy, checked by tests on the shipped documents and as warnings on a clinic's own versions. Each element is found by wording: any (one phrase), all (every phrase), signature (a signature block) or forbid (text that must not appear). Phrases are matched without regard to case.

phq-9.source: PHQ-9 (Kroenke, Spitzer and Williams); validated wording

elements.name: The nine questions and the difficulty question
all: thoughts that you would be better off dead
poco interés o placer en hacer cosas
se ha sentido decaído(a), deprimido(a) o sin esperanzas
pensamientos de que estaría mejor muerto(a)
qué tanta dificultad le han dado estos problemas

elements.name: The authors' reproduction statement

any: no se requiere permiso para reproducir

elements.name: The three questions

how many drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day when you are drinking
how often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion
con qué frecuencia consume alguna bebida alcohólica
con qué frecuencia toma 6 o más bebidas alcohólicas en un solo día

elements.name: Answers scored 0 to 4

all: 4 o más veces a la semana (4)
a diario o casi a diario (4)

procedure-consent.source: Informed consent: the procedure, why it is done, its benefits, risks and other choices, and a chance to ask questions

elements.name: What the procedure is and why
Benefits, risks and other choices, including none
all: other choices, including not having it

elements.name: Questions answered; may change their mind
Signature

asq.source: ASQ Suicide Risk Screening Tool (NIMH Toolkit, revised 9/29/25); validated wording, public domain

elements.name: The four questions and the acuity question
all: have you wished you were dead
better off if you were dead
have you ever tried to kill yourself
thoughts of killing yourself right now

elements.name: What an acute positive screen requires
all: cannot leave until evaluated for safety

elements.name: A brief suicide safety assessment after a non-acute positive screen
Crisis resources for every patient
